title: Beaches in Caribbean and Gulf of Mexico Overwhelmed with Record Amounts of Seaweed
summary: Caribbean and Gulf of Mexico beaches have been affected by record levels of seaweed, with the Mexican government taking action against it. The Mexican government has escalated its efforts to combat the issue, which is causing problems for tourists and locals alike. The seaweed, also known as 'sargassum,' has been washing up on beaches in the Caribbean and Gulf of Mexico since last year. The Mexican government claims that it has increased its efforts to clean up the beaches and prevent further pollution. However, some critics argue that the government's actions are not enough to address the root cause of the problem. The issue is also affecting other countries in the region, including Belize and Costa Rica.
summary_points: Caribbean and Gulf of Mexico beaches have been affected by record levels of seaweed since last year.

summary_hi: कैरिबियन और गुल्फ ऑफ मेक्सिको के समुद्र तट बहुत अधिक सागरी से भर गए हैं, जिसमें मेक्सिको सरकार ने इस पर कार्रवाई की है। मेक्सिको सरकार ने अपनी प्रयासों में वृद्धि की है और सागरी को समुद्र से बाहर करने के लिए बड़े पैमाने पर सफाई कार्य शुरू किए हैं। हालांकि, कुछ आलोचक मानते हैं कि सरकार की कार्रवाई पर्यावरणीय समस्या के मूल कारण को हल नहीं कर सकती।
summary_points_hi: कैरिबियन और गुल्फ ऑफ मेक्सिको समुद्र तट सागरी से भर गए हैं।
